characters.label: Geth trooper
characters.note: ME1's geth trooper (Eden Prime, BIOA_PRO10_05_DSG), MAT_1a (ME1's usual gray-lavender look; MAT_8a is a blue variant). ME1's geth have no locomotion of their own: they play the human rifle set (HMM_CB_Rifle, in SFXGame.pcc) with the geth hold GTH_CB_Rifle_CB_IdleOffset added over HMM_CB_Rifle_CB_IdlePose (BIOG_Hench_O's AddCombatIdleOffset). DrawnIdle and the directional DrawnWalk*/DrawnRun* are those rifle clips (CharacterModel.armed: always the combat gaits), the Aim* poses ME1's rifle aim set without the hold; Activate is ME1's power-up. ME1 ragdolls, so the death (DeathKnockBack2 is only its 0.3 s lead-in), flinches, stagger, and evades are ME3's (SFXPawn_GethTrooper.pcc, HMM_DG_A). Server-owned NPCs (GethTrooper), not a player pick. Cover (chunk 1 of the cover plan): ME3's rifle cover set (HMM_CB_RifleCover_*, the cover reloads, and the mid-cover shield recover, SFXPawn_GethTrooper.pcc), each held-rifle clip with the geth hold added; Mirrored = the left-side version.
